title: Compiler Module — Call-Site Swap and Typst Eviction
description:
Wave 3 of the compiler-replaces-Typst plan (/Users/ueli/.claude/plans/we-want-to-replace-serialized-pinwheel.md). Follows the syntax-kernel ticket (26/08/04/COMPILER-MODULE-MATH-NOTATION-SYNTAX-KERNEL, Wave 0+1) and the snippet-pipeline ticket (26/08/05/COMPILER-MODULE-SNIPPET-PIPELINE-FONTS-TEXT-MATH-LAYOUT-SVG, Wave 2), which together delivered a working `compiler::compile_snippet_to_svg(&str, SnippetOptions) -> Result<SvgSnippet, CompileError>` — a semio math notation parser + real OpenType-MATH-driven layout engine + SVG emitter, visually verified against 15 representative snippets.

This ticket does the actual swap: replace both real Typst call sites with the new compiler, then remove the typst/typst-svg/typst-assets dependencies entirely.

Call site 1: 🧰️framework/🛍️products/💻️os/🔨️modules/♾️infinite/🖼️canvas/⚡️implementations/🦀️rust/📦️lib.rs — icon_codec module. `Icon::Typst { src }` variant, `BoardTypstWorld` (a typst::World impl), `board_typst_compile_markup_to_svg`, `board_typst_markup_to_svg`, wire decode of `typst:` prefix / bare `$...$` sugar, `resolve_typst_src`/`resolve_emoji_body`/`resolve_text_body` (page-preamble string templating), three font-book OnceLocks, host_asset module (TYPST_DEFAULT_FONTS_ASSET_HANDLE).

Call site 2: ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🎞️animate/🔨️modules/🫀️core/⚡️implementations/🦀️rust/📦️lib.rs — mod text. `AnimateTypstWorld`, `typst_compile_markup_to_svg`, `typst_markup_to_svg`, `typst_asset_font_list`, `svg_to_vobject`/`collect_svg_paths` (SVG-to-BezPath vectorization to keep — only the typst-generation step is replaced), `MathText { inner, latex }` (field renames to `src`), `Text`/`DecimalNumber`/`Paragraph`/`Code` types, `Matrix::math` consumer.

Also: font plumbing ("guestslim") repointing — `🔌️plugin/🖥️host` serves `typst_assets::fonts()`, needs to serve the compiler's vendored font set instead (compiler_world::embedded_fonts(), already built in Wave 2, ~1.4MB vs typst-assets' ~15MB); styling token rename `ui_styling::metrics::typst` → `metrics::math` across 🔣️tokens.json/🤖️generated.rs/🎨️theme/🔣️mono.theme.json/TS tokens; React icon kind "typst"→"math" plus labels/placeholder/CSS in 🖱️ui/⚛️react and 🎨️ui.css; puzzle 2d engine test fixture "typst:$x^2$"→"math:x^2"; dev script.ts guestslim asset pipeline rename; regenerate the checked-in demonstrator _vendor blob; audit AGENTS.md mentions (do NOT edit AGENTS.md files per repo policy — flag instead).

Migrated math syntax: the new notation is NOT Typst syntax (approved by the user earlier) — e.g. "x^2" stays "x^2" (same), but Typst-specific constructs if any existing stored/fixture content uses them need hand-migration to the new grammar (frac(a,b), mat(1,2;3,4), etc — see compiler_syntax's 📖️math.grammar and its round-trip tests for the full notation).

This is a sensitive, cross-cutting change touching two real production crates plus generated styling assets — work carefully, run cargo check/test/clippy after each file, and verify the dev preview (os/dev) still renders icons/animate text correctly before considering this done.
